data.name: Galang
data.gender_notes: Galang is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Tagalog language, Galang translates to 'strong' or 'powerful' in English. It is a popular Filipino name, especially among Christian families. The name Galang carries the meaning “Strong, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Galang usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner strength and resilience.
data.etymology: Galang belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Galang total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Galang carries cultural significance in the Filipino society as it conveys strength and resilience. It is a name given to children who are presumed to possess great fortitude and potential to overcome any challenges that they may face in life. In a traditional Filipino context, parents would wish their children to carry the 'Galang' name as a way of inspiring them to grow up to be strong and robust individuals.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Galang signifies the innate strength that individuals possess from God. It serves as a reminder that His divine grace and love continue to empower us in times of adversity. The name also highlights the importance of developing one's spiritual strength and relying on their faith to face life's challenges. Ultimately, it signifies the belief that we are all endowed with the strength of the Almighty, making every one of us Galang in the eyes of God.
